## Walkthrough

These changes introduce support for the `fused_add_rmsnorm_h6144` operator, a fused RMSNorm computation with a fixed hidden size of 6144 (for GLM-5). The addition includes documentation updates, tracing configuration, a formal operator definition, a correctness test implementation, and workload trace data.

## Changes

|Cohort / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Documentation** <br> `docs/model_coverage.mdx`|Marked `fused_add_rmsnorm_h6144` as covered (✅) for Mixtral 8x22B and MiniMax-Text-01 sections; updated coverage narrative text to reflect the newly supported operator.|
|**Tracing Configuration** <br> `flashinfer_bench/tracing/presets.py`|Added registry entry mapping `"fused_add_rmsnorm_h6144"` to the existing `"axes_only"` tracing configuration in `get_full_configs()`.|
|**Operator Definition** <br> `flashinfer_trace/definitions/rmsnorm/fused_add_rmsnorm_h6144.json`|New JSON schema defining the `fused_add_rmsnorm_h6144` operator with fixed `hidden_size=6144`, input/output tensor specifications in BF16, epsilon of `1e-5`, and embedded PyTorch reference implementation.|
|**Test Implementation** <br> `flashinfer_trace/tests/references/test_fused_add_rmsnorm_h6144.py`|New correctness test script that loads the operator definition, compiles and executes the reference implementation, compares against FlashInfer's fused kernel, and validates outputs using configurable tolerances; includes pytest entry point and batch-size iteration harness.|
|**Workload Trace Data** <br> `flashinfer_trace/workloads/rmsnorm/fused_add_rmsnorm_h6144.jsonl`|New JSONL workload file with 8 trace entries, each specifying the operator definition and random input configurations across varying batch sizes (1 to 14521).|
